$comment: One template family: the heigin.com landing page. scripts/build-registry.mjs turns every entry in `items` into a registry item at /r/<name>.json; apps/docs/scripts/build-catalog.mjs turns them into /templates/<name> pages. License tier per item lives in source/licenses.json.
title: SaaS landing page
requirements: A "@/" import alias pointing at your source root (the shadcn default)
setup: Install the item with the shadcn CLI. It adds the files listed above plus landing-core, which every item shares.

Import the stylesheet once in your global CSS, after Tailwind and the HeiGin tokens: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "@heigin/ui/styles.css"; @import "@heigin/ui/tailwind.css"; @import "./landing.css";
Edit lib/landing-config.ts: brand, copy, links, logos and data all live there.

items.name: landing-core
items.title: Landing core
items.description: Shared foundation for every landing item: the content config, section shell, scroll reveal, brand mark, replaceable backdrop and the stylesheet. Included with any section, bundle or the full page.
items.responsive: The section shell uses a 1180px container with 20px gutters on phones and 40px from 768px up.
replaceable: Brand mark: a monogram tile until brand.logoSrc is set.
Backdrop: a built-in CSS gradient until theme.backdropImage is set. The landscape shown in the preview is not part of the download; point theme.backdropImage at your own image.

items.name: landing-header
items.title: Header with dropdown navigation
items.description: Announcement strip and a sticky header. The desktop nav uses one dropdown panel that morphs between groups, with an optional featured tile; phones get a full-height menu.
items.responsive: Dropdown navigation from 1024px up. Below that the nav collapses into a menu button that opens a scrollable sheet and locks page scroll.
replaceable: Navigation labels, links and the featured tile copy.

items.name: landing-hero
items.title: Hero with product demo
items.description: Headline and actions above a framed, auto-playing product demo: six scenes of a CRM-style app crossfade in place, with a pause control. Autoplay stops off-screen, on keyboard focus and for reduced motion.
items.responsive: Headline and copy sit side by side from 1024px and stack below it. The demo frame is 9:14 on phones (sidebar hidden), 4:5 on tablets and 1.61:1 on desktop.
replaceable: The demo's accounts, people and messages are fictional sample data in product-demo.tsx. Edit the arrays in that file to tell your own product story.
Source labels in the demo name third-party products as plain text (for example a meeting or chat app). Change them to the tools your product works with.

items.name: landing-logo-strip
items.title: Customer logo strip
items.description: A quiet row of customer names and marks for social proof directly under the hero.
items.responsive: A centred row that wraps onto more lines on narrow screens.
replaceable: Ships with placeholder names and monogram tiles. Add a logo only for customers who have agreed to be shown.

items.name: landing-workflows
items.title: Workflow card grid
items.description: A 2x2 grid of cards over the backdrop. Each card frames a small looping product scene: a timeline filling in, a draft awaiting approval, a meeting brief, a list of stalled accounts.
items.responsive: Two columns from 1024px, one column below. Scenes animate only while in view and jump to their final state for reduced motion.
replaceable: Scene content is fictional sample data in workflow-scenes.tsx.
Source labels name third-party products as plain text. Change them to match your integrations.

items.name: landing-integrations
items.title: Integrations marquee
items.description: A tinted band with a heading, a link out and a slow, seamless marquee of integrations that pauses on hover and keyboard focus.
items.responsive: Heading and link sit side by side from 1024px and stack below. The marquee fades at both edges and stays still for reduced motion.
replaceable: Ships with generic icons and category names, not brand logos. Third-party marks are trademarks of their owners: add a logo only where you have the right to show it.

items.name: landing-deep-dives
items.title: Numbered feature deep dives
items.description: Three numbered feature sections on alternating bands: heading on the left, long-form copy on the right and a framed product scene underneath.
items.responsive: Heading and copy sit side by side from 1024px and stack below. The framed scene is capped at 1024px wide.
replaceable: Scene content is fictional sample data in workflow-scenes.tsx.
Source labels name third-party products as plain text. Change them to match your integrations.

items.name: landing-newsroom
items.title: Newsroom cards
items.description: Three post cards. A post can show one of three coded, animated thumbnails in place of an image, or fall back to the backdrop with its title over it.
items.responsive: Three columns from 768px, one column below.
replaceable: Post titles, summaries and links. Thumbnail content is fictional sample data.

items.name: landing-testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: A tinted band with a heading, an action and customer quote cards in a two-column grid.
items.responsive: Two columns from 768px, one column below.
replaceable: Ships with placeholder quotes and monogram tiles. Publish only quotes and logos the customer has approved.

items.name: landing-faq
items.title: FAQ accordion
items.description: A single-open accordion with a spring height transition, beside a heading.
items.responsive: Heading and list sit side by side from 1024px and stack below.
replaceable: Questions and answers.

items.name: landing-final-cta
items.title: Closing call-to-action banner
items.description: A contained, rounded banner over the backdrop with a closing headline, one line of copy and up to two actions.
items.responsive: Scales with the viewport up to 1279px wide; actions wrap on narrow screens.
replaceable: Headline, copy and both action links.

items.name: landing-footer
items.title: Footer with link columns
items.description: Brand block, four link columns, a legal row and an oversized wordmark.
items.responsive: Five columns from 768px; a single stacked column below.
replaceable: Link groups, tagline and the optional badge image.

items.name: landing-bundle-product-story
items.title: Product story bundle
items.description: The three sections that explain a product through animated scenes: the hero demo, the workflow card grid and the numbered deep dives.
replaceable: See each section.

items.name: landing-bundle-trust
items.title: Trust bundle
items.description: Social proof and objection handling: the customer logo strip, testimonials and the FAQ accordion.
replaceable: See each section.

items.name: landing-bundle-chrome
items.title: Site chrome bundle
items.description: Everything around the content: the header with dropdown navigation, the closing call-to-action banner and the footer.
replaceable: See each section.

items.name: landing-page
items.title: SaaS landing page
items.description: The complete landing page in one install: header, hero with product demo, logo strip, workflow grid, integrations, three deep dives, newsroom, testimonials, FAQ, closing banner and footer. Section order and visibility come from one config array.
items.responsive: Every section is responsive from 375px up with no horizontal scroll. See each section for its breakpoints.
replaceable: All copy, links, logos and data are placeholders in lib/landing-config.ts.
No third-party logos, customer quotes or artwork ship with the template. The landscape in the preview is HeiGin's own and is not part of the download.
